options.label: Role Identity and Provenance
options.description: Canonical role key, display name, description, ownership/provenance, site scope, clone source and read-only default/editable/user-count diagnostics.

rules: Role key must be namespace-safe and must not collide with an existing native/provider role.
Default/editable/user-count fields are read-only diagnostics, never authored authorization truth.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

security.policy_notes: Role identity changes never bypass target-role policy or anti-lockout checks.

multisite.notes: Role identity is site-contextual in multisite.

options.label: Guarded Role Lifecycle
options.description: Create, clone, display-name rename, compare/diff, delete planning with replacement, default-role handling, restore defaults and presets.

rules: Delete and role-key migration are not executable under Issue #615.
Destructive operations require affected-user impact, replacement/default-role handling and separate runtime authorization.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

security.policy_notes: Anti-lockout and target-role policy are mandatory before any future mutation.

options.label: Capability Registry
options.description: Read-only registry spanning WordPress core, CPT-generated, taxonomy-generated, WPE, provider/plugin and unknown/orphan capability keys with provenance when safely known.

rules: Registry is an inventory/read model and does not claim ownership of CPT or taxonomy definitions.
Unknown/plugin capabilities remain visible rather than silently discarded.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: Three-State Capability Matrix
options.description: Role capability entries preserve explicit allow=true, explicit deny=false and absent as three distinct states; removing an entry returns to absent rather than writing false.

rules: Never collapse explicit false and absence.
Search/group selection must not silently mutate capabilities outside the visible scope.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

security.policy_notes: Future grant/deny/remove mutations require target-role policy and anti-lockout checks.

options.label: Effective Capability Diagnostics
options.description: Read-only primitive/meta classification, object-context requirements, provenance, deprecated/unknown state and dependency impact without flattening contextual authorization into a naive role boolean.

rules: Meta-capability results require the relevant user/object context.
Diagnostics disclose dynamic-filter and Super Admin caveats.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: User Role and Override Assignment Policy
options.description: Models individual/bulk role assignment, multiple-role users, removal/replacement semantics and individual user capability overrides as distinct data layers.

rules: Multiple roles must be preserved where native/plugin semantics allow.
Individual user capability overrides are displayed and edited separately from role definitions.
Replace-role semantics must explicitly disclose removal of prior roles.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

security.policy_notes: No user-role mutation is authorized by Issue #615.

multisite.notes: Assignments are evaluated against explicit site/network context.

competitor_evidence.capability: Multiple roles and user capability controls

options.label: Assignment Impact Preview
options.description: Read-only user filters, affected-user counts and audit references shown before any future assignment/delete/remap workflow.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: Anti-Lockout and Recovery Policy
options.description: Protects administrator-equivalent recovery paths, current actor safety and future destructive workflows using effective capability risk rather than role-name assumptions.

rules: Do not rely on the literal administrator role name as the only recovery signal.
Recovery execution remains separately gated from this contract.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

security.policy_notes: High-impact operations must fail closed when recovery cannot be demonstrated.

competitor_evidence.capability: Administrator role safety and recovery patterns

options.label: Target Role Policy
options.description: Read-only policy describing which roles the current actor may view/edit/assign, respecting WordPress editable-role filters and WPE Policy.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: Site, Network and Super Admin Context
options.description: Separates site-scoped roles from network context and treats Super Admin as special multisite authority rather than an ordinary role/capability checkbox.

rules: Every read or future mutation request must carry explicit site/network scope.
Super Admin must not be persisted as an ordinary site role state.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

multisite.notes: Site role data and network Super Admin authority stay distinguishable.

options.label: Permission Simulator
options.description: Read-only capability simulation for selected role/user/context without changing sessions, impersonating a user or mutating role state.

rules: Simulation never changes the authenticated principal or creates a user-switching session.
Contextual meta capabilities require object context.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: Effective Capability Explain
options.description: Explains role entries, individual user overrides, primitive/meta mapping, object context, Super Admin effects and diagnostic caveats without overclaiming final authorization truth.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: Role Import and Export Policy
options.description: Diff-first role/capability portability with environment-sensitive provider/unknown capability warnings; no mutation occurs under Issue #615.

rules: Import is preview/diff only until separately authorized runtime exists.
Unknown/provider capabilities must be preserved and warned rather than silently discarded.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: Revision, Diff and Forward-Repair Policy
options.description: Read/review contract for role configuration snapshots, diffs and restore/forward-repair previews before any later authorized mutation.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

options.label: Canonical Read-Only Role Catalog
options.description: Reusable peer-facing role catalog with explicit site/network scope, role key/display/provenance and primitive capability entries preserving true/false/absent.

rules: Peer surfaces consume this canonical service rather than reading wp_roles/get_role directly.
No mutation methods are part of the read seam.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

security.policy_notes: Service callers still pass through canonical Policy; read seam is not an authorization bypass.

multisite.notes: Caller must request explicit site/network context.

wpe_exceed.reason: Provides one canonical, bounded role/capability truth seam reusable by Taxonomy and other peer surfaces instead of duplicated direct WordPress role-store inspection.

options.label: Bounded Capability Impact Query
options.description: For a primitive capability and explicit site/network context, returns explicit-allow roles, explicit-deny roles, absent roles and caveats without pretending dynamic meta-capability resolution is a static role matrix.

rules: Explicit allow, explicit deny and absence must remain distinguishable.
Meta capability final truth is not inferred without required user/object context.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

wpe_exceed.reason: Allows dependency-aware peer previews such as Taxonomy role impact while keeping role truth owned by Surface 30.

options.label: Bounded Effective Capability Explain Query
options.description: Optional contextual query that keeps role entries, individual user overrides, meta-cap mapping and Super Admin effects separately attributable for diagnostics.

rules: User-specific data is returned only for a bounded explicitly requested diagnostic context.
No session impersonation is permitted.

runtime.effect: Contract only; Surface 30 production runtime remains separately gated by a later exact-main authorization.

wpe_exceed.reason: Preserves explanation provenance across role, user, meta-cap and Super Admin layers instead of flattening authorization into one opaque boolean.

options.label: Reject Role-Name Authorization and Super Admin Checkbox Modeling
options.description: Role-name-only authorization and modeling Super Admin as an ordinary role checkbox are explicitly prohibited.
options.parity_reason: WordPress capability/policy semantics and multisite authority cannot be safely represented by role-name checks or a fake site role toggle.

runtime.effect: Prohibited contract item; no runtime implementation is allowed.

must_not: Persist Super Admin as a normal role capability

options.label: Reject Silent Destructive Role Delete or Key Migration
options.description: Role deletion/key migration without explicit impact, replacement, recovery and a separately authorized destructive workflow is prohibited.
options.parity_reason: Silent destructive mutation can strand users, invalidate default-role assumptions and remove administrator recovery paths.

runtime.effect: Prohibited contract item; no runtime implementation is allowed.

must_not: Migrate role keys without a separate safety authorization
